Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.util

Class PvtSeparatorPath

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.util.PvtSeparatorPath
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PvtSeparatorPath extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable equilibrium separator path with explicit final product-volume conditions and component accounting.

At each stage gas leaves the train and is flashed separately to the final specified conditions. All its products, including condensate or water, are retained. The oil and aqueous phases continue together to the next stage. This is an equilibrium material-accounting protocol, not a separator sizing, efficiency or transient model. The caller supplies a qualified EOS and the phase options needed for the fluid; no water or electrolyte model is substituted.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
